boundaries: Native executable execution qualifies the recorded bounded reading, destination conversion, creation and preservation profiles on macOS arm64. Composed PDF NativeAOT, other architectures, public packages and native hosts require separate evidence.

Fixed hour/millisecond, minute/millisecond and second/millisecond selected formats extend the five previously qualified fixed-duration ranges to eight. Typed raw-second values, day serials and explicit XLSX codes are preserved.

Native Numbers uses separate millisecond components while its XLSX export uses three fractional-second digits and a terminal literal space. The shared formatter follows the exported code and preserves the display-approximation diagnostic.

All six composed PDF pages and all three native PDF pages were inspected. Every populated row and formula result is retained; width pagination and declared font substitution do not establish native geometry or typography.
Native Excel appearance for this millisecond reference, automatic units, millisecond-only totals, other label styles, locales and additional producer versions remain unqualified.
reproduction: Run the published OfficeIMO.IWork.AotSmoke executable directly.
